items.source: An immutable ordered set of target objects for Document to Object conversions. Object paths can be extended via push(Object, MongoPersistentEntity, Object).
items.translation: 用于将 `Document` 转换为 Object 的目标对象的不可变有序集合。对象路径可以通过 `push(Object, MongoPersistentEntity, Object)` 进行扩展。

items.source: Thomas Darimont, Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Christoph Strobl

A path of objects nested into each other. The type allows access to all parent objects currently in creation even
when resolving more nested objects. This allows to avoid re-resolving object instances that are logically equivalent
to already resolved ones.
items.translation: 一条相互嵌套的对象路径。该类型允许在解析更深层的嵌套对象时，访问当前处于创建状态的所有父级对象。这可以避免重新解析那些逻辑上等同于已解析对象的实例。
